[FACT] User has a Labrador named Max.  
[EVENT] User is considering enrolling Max in obedience training classes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Obedience training is an excellent way to strengthen the bond with Max and help him become a well-behaved pup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Obedience training schools typically require vaccination records for dogs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Common vaccinations required for obedience training classes include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Rabies - usually mandated by law in most states.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Distemper, Hepatitis, Parvovirus (DHPP) - a core vaccination.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Bordetella (Kennel Cough) - often required in schools with multiple dogs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Parainfluenza - sometimes required, often included in DHPP.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should check with the obedience training school for specific vaccination requirements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User may need a health certificate from a veterinarian for Max.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Joint pain is not uncommon for Labradors, even at a relatively young age.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Labradors are prone to hip and elbow dysplasia, which can lead to arthritis and joint pain.
